newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Stores gets Melville payment.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Stores gets Melville payment.

text.p: Consolidated Stores Corp said on Wednesday it received $29.7 million from Melville Corp as final settlement on Consolidated's purchase of Kay-Bee Toys.
The payment cut the actual purchase price to $285.3 million from the originally announced $315 million.
The initial purchase price of $315 million was derived using estimates of Kay-Bee's balance sheet prior to the acquisition date of May 5, 1996, the company said.
Post-closing adjustments represent the difference between the initial estimates and final audited balance sheet of Kay-Bee as of the acquisition date of May 5, 1996, Consolidated said.
